rate.source_name: Danish Ministry of Taxation and Growth — final answer to Folketing Tax Committee question 449, 2026-10-06, p. 2
rate.note: Positive absence finding replaces the earlier incomplete search. The tax minister’s October 2026 answer describes the proposed overnight tourism tax as a new tax requiring a defined model. The municipality separately states it lacks legal authority to introduce a tourism tax without national legislation. These are positive government statements, corroborated by the rejected authorising proposal. No enacted future accommodation-tax commencement was verified. This finding applies to Copenhagen, not an unsupported claim about every territory in the Danish Realm. The hypothetical amount discussed in the parliamentary question is not an enacted or announced future rate and is deliberately not entered as a tax value.

periods.exemptions: Not applicable to the absent statutory accommodation visitor tax. VAT and contractual property charges are separate.

absence_evidence.source_name: Danish Ministry of Taxation and Growth — final answer to Folketing Tax Committee question 449
absence_evidence.finding: The minister states that introducing the proposed overnight tourism tax would create a new tax requiring a defined model. The answer addresses both national and Copenhagen/Aarhus scenarios. It describes a hypothetical policy, not an existing levy or an enacted future rate.

absence_evidence.source_name: Københavns Kommune — February 2026 municipal briefing, p. 14
absence_evidence.finding: Explicit statement that the municipality lacks the necessary legal authority for a tourism tax. The statement is in the municipality-authored section, not an expert opinion section.
absence_evidence.retrieval_note: Official-host PDF text read through web retrieval. The municipal URL has an expiring delivery signature; the unsigned URL did not load. The publisher mirror, linked from https://www.wedodemocracy.dk/publikationer/, was downloaded and independently text-checked: cover publication date February 2026, municipal authorship on pp. 12–14, and explicit absence of legal authority on p. 14. The mirror hash identifies the checked copy. It is the same titled municipal contribution, not a publisher opinion.

absence_evidence.finding: Proposal to authorise municipal tourism taxes rejected on 2025-04-03; it is not an enacted tax.

absence_evidence.source_name: Folketing — Tax Committee question 449, 2025–26 second session
absence_evidence.finding: Question dated 2026-09-22 asks about introducing an overnight tax nationally or only in Copenhagen/Aarhus. The final recheck shows it answered on 2026-10-06; that ministerial answer is now the primary evidence above. The earlier retrieval note describing it as unanswered is superseded. Neither the hypothetical question nor its revenue model constitutes an enacted rate or commencement law.

unresolved: Research only: this is not the production cost schema and the app must never read it. A validated transform must reject unconfirmed and disputed records, and retain all product, geography, date, eligibility and purchase-channel restrictions on confirmed records.

research-v3: transit envelopes carry validity_area. Airport transfers use journey_legs and named taxi_tariffs categories; overall journey time, estimated taxi ranges and attraction visit durations are deliberately absent. Each taxi category has base_fare, per_km, per_waiting_minute and airport_surcharge envelopes. An optional published_waiting_rate preserves an hourly source without deriving a per-minute figure.

Prices are observations checked on the collection date, not promises for a future trip. A current official page without an explicit effective date is identified as such. No currency conversion, averages, estimated amounts or arithmetic replacement for a missing product are used. Null does not mean zero.

day_pass records only an explicitly specified validity product; service-day and consecutive-hour products must not be treated as interchangeable. pass_72h is not calculated from shorter passes. Nonexistence requires positive evidence, not an unsuccessful search.

Eating-out figures are named menu observations, not representative city averages. A published per-person menu has not been doubled to manufacture a two-person total. The midrange category is not an official restaurant classification.

The five attractions are a research selection rather than a verified popularity ranking. Booking evidence is placed in entry_price.note because the agreed boolean has no envelope. Null booking status is unknown; no availability or queue-time claim is made.

An empty accommodation_charges array means no non-statutory charge was verified in this research, not that every property is fee-free. Conditional levies must be matched to an actual property; universal=false forbids automatic addition to every trip.

Airport scope follows destination codes found in repository configuration/catalogue, not an independently verified live origin-flight schedule. Named endpoint fares are not terminal-to-hotel prices. No comparison claim is made where cheaper conditional products or alternate services remain unverified.
An exact two-person dine-in menu total was not verified. Tivoli requires a visit-date quote. Rosenborg booking policy differs between venue and partner museum network.

TAXA 4×35 uses simultaneous distance and elapsed-time charging. Its schedule is not a universal city tariff, and its airport surcharge is unconfirmed. Dantaxi separately publishes an airport surcharge, but mixing operators would produce an invalid fare.

The current operator airport fare conflicts with the national tourism page; all observations retained. Conditional Rejsekort fares and discounts prevent a verified absolute-cheapest claim for every traveller.

research-v4 adds the closed tax basis registry and calculation metadata. Conditional means the recorded formula supports only its named case with all required inputs; it does not mean a guest total is ready. Unknown basis, unsupported assessment, missing inputs and unresolved evidence must cause explicit refusal, never an average, nearest-shape mapping or zero.

Tax follow-up: statutory accommodation visitor tax is now sourced not_offered, under the new not_levied basis. There is no verified future effective accommodation-tax period to encode; political proposals do not create one. Recheck for future travel.

FX follow-up: DKK is now supported as an evidence currency and included in the refreshed ECB snapshot. Positive confirmed DKK observations can be converted under the registry policy; each cost still needs valid source/product conditions. The statutory absence finding itself needs no conversion.
